title: 4 bedroom single level home
description:
This fully renovated house is located centrally in East Nashville on a huge quiet tree lined corner lot with plenty of parking.  House is designed for specifically for Airbnb.  Entire Space is on one level, zero step entry with large walk in showers, great for elderly folks or children.  Very open floor plan  makes it great for entertaining larger groups. Great location just minutes from downtown and most of the hot spots in East Nashville.

The space
mid century ranch, open floor plan makes this house a perfect space to entertain and relax while you visit Nashville.  High quality materials  throughout the entire house.  Marble and granite kitchen and bathrooms, luxury hotel quality beds, designer furnishings, outdoor gas grill, Huge corner lot with lots of parking.

Guest access
Entire Property.

Other things to note
Please make sure your guests count is accurate.  The City of Nashville strictly enforces occupancy limits and can cancel my short term rental permit if the house is over occupied.  If you need to add more guests after your booking, please let me know prior to the beginning of your stay.   Please understand that undisclosed additional guests may result in the cancelation of the  reservation and forfeiture of the deposit.

Bookings made prior to November 4th 2019 will receive a Nashville city hotel tax bill separate from the original payment to airbnb.
